title: Knuckle Sub
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A dry, clicky 808 sub built from a single sine voice: a sharp pitch-envelope knock cracks the attack while the body sits deep in the sub register. Over 16 cycles the penv depth, knock decay, and ladder filter sweep all travel on separate clocks, morphing the hit from a tight tick to a roaring drop and back.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 [eb1 c1] g0 c1 [g0 bb0] eb1 c1>*2").s("sine")
    .penv(sine.slow(16).range(18, 36)).pattack(0.001).pdecay(perlin.slow(11).range(0.02, 0.09))
    .lpf(sine.slow(24).range(280, 2600)).resonance(11).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(saw.slow(13).range(1.5, 5)).lpattack(0.004).lpdecay(0.12)
    .attack(0.001).decay(0.18).sustain(0.55).release(0.05)
    .shape(sine.slow(19).range(0.1, 0.4)).coarse("<1 1 2 1>/8")
    .off(1/16, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.22).pan(0.7).pdecay(0.03))
    .room(0.08).gain(0.92)
)
